verses.1: And David, the king, said to all the people, “Shalom, my son. One man has been chosen by God. He is a young man and kind-hearted. His work is great, for no one else can do this work. It’s a gift from God.”
verses.2: And with all my strength, I prepared gold for the house of the Lord. Silver for silver, and copper for copper. Iron for iron, and wood for wood. Stone from the mountains, and stone from the hills. All kinds of precious stones, and stones from Shishik for decoration.
verses.3: And while I was in the house of God, I had gold and silver vessels. I gave these vessels to the house of God, above all my other offerings that I made for the holy place.
verses.4: Three thousand pieces of gold, made of fine gold; and seven thousand pieces of silver, finely polished for use in building the walls of the temples.
verses.5: To gold for its value, and to silver for its worth. And all kinds of work are done by hired hands. But who will be able to please the Lord today?
verses.6: And they gave gifts to the officers of the fathers, to the officers of Israel, to the officers of the tribes and peoples, and to the officers of the king’s court.
verses.7: And they gave as offerings for the service of the Temple: gold worth five thousand pieces, and many fine vessels; silver worth twelve thousand pieces; also many pearls and gold jewelry worth one thousand pieces each. And they also gave iron worth eighty thousand pieces.
verses.8: And when stones were found there, they were given to the priests of Jehovah by Jehiel the Gerasunite.
verses.9: The people were happy with their decision to follow God’s commands. They obeyed God wholeheartedly. Even King David was very pleased with this decision.
verses.10: And David blessed the LORD in front of all the people. He said, “Blessed are you, LORD, God of Israel! Our Father from everlasting to everlasting.”
verses.11: To You, O God of greatness and glory, of honor and immortality. For everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You, O God of kingship and of all things.
verses.12: And all the strength and power lie before you. You are the one who rules over everything. In your hands lies power and greatness. In your hands also lies the ability to grow and strengthen everything.
verses.13: And now, our God, we praise you and glorify your name.
verses.14: And who am I, and whose people am I, that I should be constrained to do such a thing? It’s all because of you; it’s because of you that we have been given this task.
verses.15: We are strangers before you, and we dwell here like all our ancestors did, as if we were mere dust on this earth. There is no place for us here.
verses.16: Yehova, our God, all these things that You have prepared for Your house, for Your holiness, are all Yours.
verses.17: And I knew, O God, that you are in my heart. From among the righteous, you desire me. In my heart, I have chosen to serve you. All these things have happened now. And now, your people who are here, I see with joy that I can serve you.
verses.18: May Jehovah, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our ancestors, keep this forever. May it serve as a reminder for your people’s hearts. And may their hearts be committed to you.
verses.19: And to Shelemo, my son, give me a heart that will keep your commandments, your laws, and your rules. May he do all these things, and may he build the temple that I have prepared for him.
verses.20: And David said to all the people, “Bless the LORD your God.” So all the people blessed the LORD their God. They also praised and worshiped the LORD and the king.
verses.21: And they offered sacrifices to Jehovah. They built altars for Jehovah in the evening of that day. They sacrificed ten thousand sheep, ten thousand goats, and many other offerings. All these were offered as sacrifices to Jehovah for all of Israel.
verses.22: And they ate and drank before Jehovah on that day with great joy. They reigned again over Solomon, son of David. They also offered sacrifices to Jehovah as priests and musicians.
verses.23: And Solomon sat on the throne of God, as king under David his father. He succeeded him, and all Israel listened to him.
verses.24: And all the kings, rulers, and also all the sons of King David, they all put their hands under Solomon’s reign.
verses.25: And Jehovah made Solomon great, so that he could be seen by all the people of Israel. He gave him a kingdom that no other king had ever had before in Israel.
verses.26: And David, son of Jesse, ruled over all of Israel.
verses.27: And in the days when he ruled over Israel, he ruled for forty years. In Jerusalem, he ruled for seven years.
verses.28: And he died in a good death, after seventy years of reign. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.
verses.29: And the words of David, the first and last kings, are written as being based on the words of Jehovah, the Almighty, and also on the words of the prophet Nathan, and on the words of the prophet Gad.
verses.30: With all his kingdoms and power, and the times that passed over him, over Israel, and over all the kings of the nations.
